nodes.description: Address with privileged ownership rights, set to msg.sender in the Owned constructor.
Pending owner address, set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Public token symbol string, initialized to WSTO in the constructor.
Public token name string, initialized to WealthStoreCoin in the constructor.
Public uint8 token decimals, fixed to 18.
Total token supply minted to the deployer address in the constructor.
Mapping of address to token balance; mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping owner=>spender=>allowance; mutated by approve and transferFrom.
Owned() constructor assigning owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
Two-step ownership transfer acceptor; requires msg.sender == newOwner and rotates owner.
Token constructor setting metadata, total supply and initial balance, then emitting Transfer.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Returns the balance of a given token holder.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using safeSub/safeAdd.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] to tokens without checking the current allowance.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' and decrements the spender allowance.
Returns remaining allowance for a spender over a token owner.
Sets an allowance and then calls receiveApproval on the spender contract before returning.
Payable fallback that always reverts, rejecting raw ETH.
onlyOwner rescue function that invokes transfer on an arbitrary token contract.
Checked addition with overflow require.
Checked subtraction with underflow require.
Checked multiplication with overflow require.
Checked division requiring a non-zero denominator.
msg.sender: attacker-controlled caller used for authorization checks and balance/allowance lookups.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) executed before state finalization.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an attacker-supplied contract address.
Raw addition c = a + b inside safeAdd (guarded by require(c >= a)).
Raw subtraction c = a - b inside safeSub (guarded by require(b <= a)).
Raw multiplication c = a * b inside safeMul (guarded by a == 0 || c / a == b).

Parameter tokens of transfer.
Parameter spender of approve.
Parameter tokens of approve.
Parameter from of transferFrom.
Parameter to of transferFrom.
Parameter tokens of transferFrom.
Parameter tokenOwner of allowance.
Parameter spender of allowance.
Parameter tokenOwner of balanceOf.
Parameter spender of approveAndCall; also the target contract of the external call.

Parameter data of approveAndCall; forwarded to the external callback.

Parameter tokens of transferAnyERC20Token; amount forwarded to the external call.

edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as the initial privileged owner in the Owned constructor.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner to authorize transferOwnership.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before rotating ownership.
transfer reads and writes balances[msg.sender].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the callback.
Constructor assigns msg.sender into owner.
transferOwnership writes the supplied address into newOwner.
acceptOwnership replaces owner with newOwner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
Constructor initializes symbol.
Constructor initializes name.
Constructor initializes decimals.
Constructor mints the fixed total supply.
Constructor credits the full supply to the deployer address in balances.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner].
transfer writes sender and recipient balances.
approve writes the allowance mapping.
transferFrom decrements the allowance mapping.
transferFrom writes source and destination balances.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowance before the external call.
Parameter _newOwner is written into newOwner.
Parameter to receives the transferred tokens in transfer.
Parameter tokens is the amount subtracted from the sender in transfer.
Parameter spender indexes the allowance mapping in approve.
Parameter tokens is the allowance value stored in approve.
Parameter from is the debited account in transferFrom.
Parameter to is the credited account in transferFrom.
Parameter tokens is debited from 'from' and from the allowance in transferFrom.
Parameter tokenOwner indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
Parameter spender indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
Parameter tokenOwner indexes balances in balanceOf.
Parameter spender becomes the allowance key and external callback target in approveAndCall.
Parameter tokens is stored as the allowance in approveAndCall.
Parameter data is forwarded to the external callback in approveAndCall.
Parameter tokenAddress selects the external contract in transferAnyERC20Token.
Parameter tokens is the amount forwarded to the external call in transferAnyERC20Token.
Attacker-supplied spender address determines the callee of the receiveApproval external call.
tokens parameter flows into the external receiveApproval call payload.
Arbitrary data parameter is forwarded verbatim into the external call.
tokenAddress parameter determines the target contract of the external transfer call.
tokens parameter flows into the external transfer call amount.
msg.sender is passed as the 'from' argument of the external receiveApproval call.
transfer invokes safeSub for balance decrement.
transfer invokes safeAdd for balance increment.
transferFrom invokes safeSub on balances and allowance.
transferFrom invokes safeAdd for the destination balance.
approveAndCall performs an external contract call after writing state, enabling a reentrant receiveApproval implementation.
The callee callback can re-enter approveAndCall/transferFrom before the caller finishes execution.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to an arbitrary token contract.
The attacker-controlled token contract can re-enter the rescue function during the external call.
safeAdd performs unchecked-at-bytecode-level addition c = a + b.
safeSub performs subtraction c = a - b.
safeMul performs multiplication c = a * b.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _newOwner only exists to write the newOwner state variable inside transferOwnership; fold it into the function node.
Parameter to is only consumed by transfer when crediting balances; fold into the transfer function node.
Parameter tokens is only consumed by transfer as the debited amount; fold into the transfer function node.
Parameter spender only indexes the allowance mapping written by approve; fold into approve.
Parameter tokens is only the allowance value written by approve; fold into approve.
Parameter from is only the debited account of transferFrom; fold into transferFrom.
Parameter to is only the credited account of transferFrom; fold into transferFrom.
Parameter tokens is only the moved amount in transferFrom; fold into transferFrom.
Parameter tokenOwner only indexes the allowed mapping read by allowance; fold into allowance.
Parameter spender only indexes the allowed mapping read by allowance; fold into allowance.
Parameter tokenOwner only indexes balances in balanceOf; fold into balanceOf.
Parameter spender determines the callee of the receiveApproval external call and is the allowance key; merge into the external-call operation.
Parameter tokens is forwarded into the external receiveApproval payload; merge into the external-call operation.
Parameter data is forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval payload; merge into the external-call operation.
Parameter tokenAddress determines the external callee contract; merge into the external-call operation.
Parameter tokens is the amount forwarded to the external transfer call; merge into the external-call operation.
